skill.summary: Generates 60 high-impact tweet ideas from reference content across 5 categories. Use when someone wants to extract engaging short-form statements from content for Twitter/X, organized by harsh advice, quotes, pain points, counterintuitive truths, and key insights.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of tweet-ideas-generator.
- Generates 60 high-impact tweet ideas from user-supplied content, organized into 5 categories and 10 creative wildcards.
- Extracts and reformulates content using psychological triggers for maximum engagement and shareability.
- Accepts a wide range of reference materials including pasted text, files, and URLs.
- Outputs categorized and annotated tweet ideas, saved automatically to a timestamped markdown file.
